_meta.purpose: PptxGenJS-friendly token mirror. Use these values when building .pptx via the pptx skill.
_meta.spec: PptxGenJS expects HEX without #, fontFace as a single string, and points (pt) for spacing/font sizes.
_meta.provenance: Regenerated 2026-08-15 from jakkaritw's approved Sea Green theme (tokens.css / tokens.json) — NOT the retired CI-book glass palette. Light card + green shell aesthetic only.
_meta.note: size_pt is a presentation-medium scale (points, not the web's px type scale) — a deck is a different medium from the web app, so this is a fresh, small, purpose-built scale, not a literal mirror of font.size in tokens.json.

font._note: The web app uses the Bootstrap/system font stack, which has no single PPTX fontFace equivalent — Segoe UI is the closest practical match on the Windows machines this deck is built and viewed on.
